parameters.name: BusinessStatus
parameters.description:
The billing status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

- **Normal**: Normal.

- **FinancialLocked**: locked due to overdue payment.

parameters.name: GatewayType
parameters.description:
The type of the VPN gateway. Valid values:
- Traditional: a traditional VPN gateway that supports both IPsec-VPN and SSL-VPN features.
- Enhanced.SiteToSite: an enhanced site-to-cloud VPN gateway that supports only the IPsec-VPN feature.

parameters.name: IncludeReservationData
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include pending order data. Valid values:

- **false** (default): does not include pending order data.

- **true**: includes pending order data.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPN gateway. 

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the VPN gateway belongs.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query resource group IDs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

- **init**: initializing.

- **provisioning**: preparing.

- **active**: Normal.

- **updating**: updating.

- **deleting**: deleting.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags bound to the VPN gateway.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.

You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value.

Each tag key corresponds to one tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values at a time.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the VPN gateway belongs.

parameters.name: VpnGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPN gateway.
